title: Sonic the Hedgehog x Godzilla #4
desc:
Victory at long last! I, Dr. Eggman, have reached the solicit FIRST this time. No more tiresome heroic language and endless hope!

Now, here's another entry from my files. Never in 1 quintillion years did I foresee Shadow the Hedgehog being the key to unlocking the power of the Obsidian Emerald! In tandem with Mechagodzilla's innovative technology, I'll dominate this world and destroy the meddlesome blue rodent and Godzi—

Enough of that!

Your friendly neighborhood narrator is back to inform you that Sonic, Knuckles, Tails, Amy, and newfound ally Mothra have their hands full—from Godzilla destroying Station Square to Shadow going missing all the way to Eggman stealing Mechagodzilla! Pick up this issue to find out how they try to fix this interdimensional mess!
